strings.settings:expireovernight_help: This forces tokens to expire overnight, preventing midday interruptions for users. Instead they will be asked to multi-factor authenticate at the start of a day after expiry.
strings.settings:expiry_help: The duration a device is trusted before requiring a new multi-factor authentication.
